head: <filled at commit>

requirements.what_changed: store.publish reads the valid listing-set certificate's frames in position order, fetches each frame's bytes from ArtifactStore by the certified sha256 (re-hashed on read), and passes them to EtsyClient.publish(images=...); a missing/unreadable/non-image frame blocks before any Etsy write (store.publish_blocked). store.published records image_order with hashes.
requirements.live_root: store.publish handler (enqueued by the release chain)
requirements.remaining: hero-image experiments with rollback have no runtime path; no alt text sent; image bytes still depend on non-durable artifact storage (owner storage decision)
requirements.next_action: hero-image experiments with rollback have no runtime path; no alt text sent; image bytes still depend on non-durable artifact storage (owner storage decision)

requirements.what_changed: New store.activate handler: recomputes parity and release gates at execution, refuses in SHADOW before any read, reads the remote draft + files back and checks every sent field (price/quantity/taxonomy as sent/tags/title/description/materials/type), draft state, image count vs certified frames, files by name+exact size vs the verified publish's files_sent, and owed disclosures on the copy as Etsy holds it; then revalidates authority at execution (phase, BRAMBLELOOP_PUBLISH_AUTHORISED read now, per-job launch_authorisation, store_operator daily ceiling incl. listing fee) before EtsyClient.activate, reads back state=active, records the fee as a CostEntry. A verified publish enqueues store.activate, which verifies and refuses for lack of launch authorisation.
requirements.live_root: store.activate enqueued by store.publish after a verified publish
requirements.remaining: no owner route to enqueue store.activate with a launch_authorisation (cluster E); taxonomy properties not checked (cluster A); gated on publication_authority
requirements.next_action: no owner route to enqueue store.activate with a launch_authorisation (cluster E); taxonomy properties not checked (cluster A); gated on publication_authority

requirements.what_changed: After publish + attach_file, getListing (with Images) and getAllListingFiles are read and judged by etsy_verify.verify / verify_files; published=True only when verified; otherwise Listing.state=incomplete_on_etsy, store.publish_incomplete with the read-back, and a halting P1 incident store.publish_incomplete:<slug>@<version> (resolved by a later verified activation read-back). store.activate is only enqueued for a verified draft.
requirements.remaining: never run against real Etsy (owner-gated exercise round trip)

requirements.what_changed: EtsyClient.get_listing_files (getAllListingFiles, listings_r added to SCOPES_REQUIRED); etsy_verify.verify_files compares filename + exact size_bytes, requires sent sha256 == certified release sha256, flags stale/extra/duplicate files; Etsy exposes no file hash and the summary says so (HASH_NOT_EXPOSED_BY_ETSY). Called after every publish and in store.activate.
requirements.remaining: daily census does not re-read files per listing; language-variant and post-purchase availability checks not built; gates/first_customer not wired into readiness (not in my ownership)
requirements.next_action: daily census does not re-read files per listing; language-variant and post-purchase availability checks not built; gates/first_customer not wired into readiness (not in my ownership)

requirements.what_changed: EtsyAuthNeedsOwner in store.publish (and store.activate, shop snapshot, census, credential health) becomes one idempotent OwnerAction 'etsy.auth:reauthorise' + one P1 incident etsy.auth_needs_owner, classified (invalid_grant, revoked_access, scope_drift, no_token, changed_encryption_key); closed only when a later authenticated call works and the named scope is granted. record_auth_needs_owner is public for the orders path.
requirements.remaining: orders path (commerce/orders_ingest) belongs to cluster D
requirements.next_action: orders path (commerce/orders_ingest) belongs to cluster D

requirements.what_changed: Daily etsy.credential_health cadence: reads oauth_store.credential_health (fingerprints only), flags not-openable and scope drift vs required scopes, then one getMe through the persisting TokenProvider (refresh + rotation written back under CAS); stores an operating_readings row; opens/resolves etsy.credential_health:unhealthy and the F-541 owner path; closes reauthorise_transactions_r when transactions_r is granted.
requirements.remaining: rotation in production is proven only after deploy (owner production_window)
requirements.next_action: rotation in production is proven only after deploy (owner production_window)

requirements.what_changed: Daily etsy.listing_census cadence reads getListingsByShop for active/draft/inactive/sold_out/expired, stores the estate (id, state, taxonomy, price, quantity, ending_timestamp, should_auto_renew, ours/slug) as an operating_readings row, runs listing_census_drift against Listing rows (+ outstanding exercise drafts).
requirements.remaining: no Listing columns (remote_state/last_seen/expires_at) - kept in the reading to avoid a migration; fees, properties and per-listing files not collected
requirements.next_action: no Listing columns (remote_state/last_seen/expires_at) - kept in the reading to avoid a migration; fees, properties and per-listing files not collected

requirements.what_changed: Census compares every present listing we created field-by-field with the certified payload (title, description, tags, materials, price, quantity, taxonomy, type) and opens halting P1 etsy.listing_drift:<id> per drift; never writes to Etsy; resolves when the census sees it match.
requirements.remaining: files and image drift not compared in the census
requirements.next_action: files and image drift not compared in the census

requirements.what_changed: A created listing that vanished or changed state opens policy_violation_suspected:<id> (P1, halts_publication, source_text, deadline +2d, remediation_owner, closure_evidence) and reopens the policy_violations_check owner action; an unread census resolves nothing.
requirements.remaining: owner-recorded notices route POST /api/policy-violation belongs to cluster E
requirements.next_action: owner-recorded notices route POST /api/policy-violation belongs to cluster E

requirements.what_changed: Daily etsy.shop_snapshot stores getShop and runs assess_shop; any failed trust surface (icon, banner, title, announcement, policies, digital sale message) opens P1 etsy.shop:incomplete, which holds launch readiness via its no_open_incidents item.
requirements.remaining: a dedicated readiness item reading the snapshot (NO_EVIDENCE != pass) is outside my readiness ownership - needs_from_others
requirements.next_action: a dedicated readiness item reading the snapshot (NO_EVIDENCE != pass) is outside my readiness ownership - needs_from_others

requirements.what_changed: Snapshot closes etsy_surface:payment_settings_setup on is_etsy_payments_onboarded=true and opens a halting P1 etsy.shop:payments_drift + reopens it when it flips from true to false. No code path writes payout settings.
Vacation mode and non-CAD currency on the stored getShop open halting P1 incidents, resolved on a later reading.
requirements.remaining: only the Options getShop exposes; readiness item not added (ownership)
requirements.next_action: only the Options getShop exposes; readiness item not added (ownership)

requirements.what_changed: launch.readiness seeds etsy_surfaces.owner_queue() into OwnerAction keyed etsy_surface:<key> (idempotent, adopts keyless rows, never re-adds a done row), reason carries why-software-cannot, risk and closing evidence; readiness's close sweep skips these prefixes; the snapshot/credential cadences close them on evidence.
requirements.remaining: statement-closed actions (apps, ads-off, etc.) close only by the owner marking them done

requirements.what_changed: Same seeding as F-593: the Etsy browser-only queue now lives in the one owner queue the inbox reads.

readiness etsy_integration reads etsy_exercise breadcrumbs: ready only with credentials present AND a full run finished ok whose status starts 'EXERCISED against openapi.etsy.com' AND every exercise draft created has a verified removal; local-model runs never count. Retention now protects the three exercise actions (lifetime_total).
requirements.remaining: file-verification, search-readiness and first_customer items not added (edit only the etsy_integration item); owner-authorised round trip not run
requirements.next_action: file-verification, search-readiness and first_customer items not added (edit only the etsy_integration item); owner-authorised round trip not run

tests_run.note: the 2 failures (reaches_upload, calibrated_release) were run BEFORE the harness fix: the new F-524 image gate blocks because the harness forces the release gates but no listing-set certificate exists in that chain. The harness now forces etsy_ops.certified_images (WIP commit); rerun was in progress at checkpoint and is UNVERIFIED

tests_changed.why: client.publish moved into _publish_and_read_back (behind _publish_guarded) so read-back and F-541 wrap it; the order is now pinned through _publish_guarded and client.publish < read_back

harness forces etsy_ops.certified_images like it already forces parity/grid/release gates; the image gate is proven in test_etsy_readback_observe.py and this file keeps measuring the hash check and upload
additive: getAllListingFiles endpoint with size_bytes rows, configurable getShop body

needs_from_others: D: call runtime.etsy_ops.record_auth_needs_owner(db, e, where='orders_ingest') where commerce/orders_ingest catches EtsyAuthNeedsOwner (F-541 orders half)
E: owner route to enqueue store.activate with inputs {slug, version, launch_authorisation} (store_operator); POST /api/policy-violation for owner-recorded notices (F-568)

E/C (readiness owner): a readiness item reading etsy_ops.latest_reading(db,'etsy.shop_snapshot') via etsy_surfaces.assess_shop so NO_EVIDENCE blocks (F-515), plus F-594 items for file verification / search readiness / gates.first_customer

A: taxonomy/properties chosen in cluster A flow through etsy_ops.certified_payload (the single payload builder used by publish, activation and census); if A adds updateListingProperty, activation_readiness should also compare properties

Integrator: agents/registry.py (unowned) was edited additively (append block granting orchestrator the three etsy.* cadence job types and store_operator store.activate); ops/retention.py (unowned) got three KNOWN_READ_ACTIONS entries; release.py handle_launch_readiness got a prefix skip + seeding call
risks: etsy.credential_health and every Etsy read refresh the access token through the persisting provider, so after deploy the stored refresh token rotates daily; CAS protects races but this is the first unattended rotation in production
etsy.shop:incomplete is a P1 and will hold launch readiness (no_open_incidents) until the owner completes the shop's trust surfaces - intended, but visible

store.activate spends the Etsy listing fee (US$0.20, recorded as CA$0.27 at 1.37) only with phase, owner env grant and a per-job launch_authorisation; the launch_authorisation is an opaque non-empty string, not verified against an owner record
images depend on artifact bytes surviving (DurableArtifact recovery if kept); on ephemeral disk publish blocks with a reason rather than creating an image-less draft
listing census flags every pre-existing listing not created by this system as an unexpected P2 incident
test_cert_commerce past-shadow harness fix committed as WIP and not yet confirmed green; next_action: run tests/test_cert_commerce.py (~11 min)
